metadata.question: Did Wilmington, North Carolina receive at least 90 inches of rainfall during the year of 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use precipitation dataset (CHIRPS or GPM) - Date: 2018-01-01 to 2018-12-31 - Location: Wilmington, NC (~34.2°N, -77.9°W) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for precipitation products - Just sum total rainfall for the year 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Total rainfall calculated successfully, even if <90 inches (answer B) - >=90 inches: answer A - C1: No images in collection - C2: No valid pixels after processing - C3: Result is None/NaN or calculation fails ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions wilmington = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.9447, 34.2257]) start_date = '2018-01-01' end_date = '2018-12-31' # 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS Daily (5km resolution, good for precipitation) precip_col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \ .filterBounds(wilmington) # Check if collection is empty col_size = precip_col.size().getInfo() print(f"Images found: {col_size}") if col_size == 0: print("No precipitation data found for 2018.") print("C1") else: # 3. Sum all daily precipitation for the year total_precip_img = precip_col.select('precipitation').sum() # 4. Calculate total rainfall at Wilmington (check pixel count) stats = total_precip_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=wilmington, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).getInfo() precip_mm = stats.get('precipitation_mean') pixel_count = stats.get('precipitation_count') print(f"Valid pixels: {pixel_count}") # Check for C2 (no valid pixels) if pixel_count is None or pixel_count == 0: print("No valid pixels after processing.") print("C2") elif precip_mm is None: print("Calculation returned None.") print("C3") else: # Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) precip_inches = precip_mm / 25.4 print(f"Total rainfall 2018: {precip_inches:.2f} inches ({precip_mm:.2f} mm)") print(f"Threshold: 90 inches") # 5. Final Answer if precip_inches >= 90: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
wilmington = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.9447, 34.2257])
start_date = '2018-01-01'
end_date = '2018-12-31'

# 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS Daily (5km resolution, good for precipitation)
precip_col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .filterBounds(wilmington)

# Check if collection is empty
col_size = precip_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"Images found: {col_size}")

if col_size == 0:
    print("No precipitation data found for 2018.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Sum all daily precipitation for the year
    total_precip_img = precip_col.select('precipitation').sum()
    
    # 4. Calculate total rainfall at Wilmington (check pixel count)
    stats = total_precip_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=wilmington,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    precip_mm = stats.get('precipitation_mean')
    pixel_count = stats.get('precipitation_count')
    
    print(f"Valid pixels: {pixel_count}")
    
    # Check for C2 (no valid pixels)
    if pixel_count is None or pixel_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after processing.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif precip_mm is None:
        print("Calculation returned None.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm)
        precip_inches = precip_mm / 25.4
        
        print(f"Total rainfall 2018: {precip_inches:.2f} inches ({precip_mm:.2f} mm)")
        print(f"Threshold: 90 inches")
        
        # 5. Final Answer
        if precip_inches >= 90:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
